cohort: 8,012 live-born neonates and their mothers at Al-Zahra Hospital in Tabriz, Iran, between March 2013 and February 2014.
finding: Neonatal macrosomia was significantly associated with increased maternal age, male gender, maternal history of diabetes, and higher birth rank.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly different between macrosomic and normal birth weight infants.
